title: Integrals over finite sets against H⁰ are sums of values
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let F be a finite subset of ℝ^P (a Finset), and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be any function. Then ∫_F f dH⁰ = Σ_{x∈F} f(x). Here H⁰ = μHE[0], and the left side is the Bochner integral of f against H⁰ restricted to the set F.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), ∫ x in (F : Set (Euclid P)), f x ∂μHE[0] = ∑ x ∈ F, f x
